name: v19_news_downside_excursion_stockcomp
hypothesis: Penalize names with large downside excursion after news, then use share-based compensation burden and customer authority as slower non-EPS stabilizers.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * news_low_exc_stddev, 60), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * allocated_sbp_expense_total / sales, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry)
notes: Avoids earnings-news, EPS, CFO, ROE, and close/open; main risk is weak news reaction signal.

name: v19_news_upside_excursion_acceptance
hypothesis: Positive upside excursion after news may mark accepted good information. Pair with stock-comp discipline and customer authority.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(news_high_exc_stddev, 60), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * allocated_sbp_expense_total / sales, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry)
notes: Sign test against downside-excursion variant; strict correlation gate.

name: v19_news_volume_calm_debt_event
hypothesis: Avoid unstable news-volume spikes and debt-extinguishment event burden. This tests a calm-attention plus financing-stress mechanism.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * news_vol_stddev, 60), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(debt_extinguishment_gain_loss_value) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry)
notes: Uses debt near-miss as minority weight and avoids fnd6_aqi/quality anchors.

name: v19_pretax_uncertainty_news_downside
hypothesis: Lower pretax-income estimate dispersion plus lower downside news excursion should capture predictable fundamentals without EPS-yield exposure.
expression: 0.50 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * pretax_income_stddev, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * news_low_exc_stddev, 60), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * allocated_sbp_expense_total / sales, 126), industry)
notes: Analyst uncertainty branch; avoids est_eps/close and operating-income anchors.

name: v19_sales_dispersion_news_downside
hypothesis: Sales-estimate dispersion was weak alone; combine it with downside news reaction and stock-comp burden to test a more complete uncertainty-quality signal.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * sales_estimate_dispersion, 126), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * news_low_exc_stddev, 60), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * allocated_sbp_expense_total / sales, 126), industry)
notes: Designed as a rescue of the weak analyst-disagreement family without EPS or ROE.

name: v19_stockcomp_social_stability_news_calm
hypothesis: Share-based compensation burden had near-miss strength. Stable social sentiment and calm news volume may improve Fitness while staying distinct from accounting-quality actives.
expression: 0.50 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * allocated_sbp_expense_total / sales, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_std_dev(snt_social_value, 20), 60), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * news_vol_stddev, 60), industry)
notes: Social stability is auxiliary only because pure sentiment-volatility failed earlier.

name: v19_debt_social_stability_news_downside
hypothesis: Debt-extinguishment burden was a low-Fitness near-miss. Add stable social sentiment and low downside news excursion as orthogonal attention filters.
expression: 0.50 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(debt_extinguishment_gain_loss_value) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_std_dev(snt_social_value, 20), 60), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * news_low_exc_stddev, 60), industry)
notes: No fnd6_aqi/CFO/EPS anchor; should be low-correlation if it has enough strength.

name: v19_writedown_vector_news_downside
hypothesis: Vector writedown was close to the Fitness line in v18. Combine vector-averaged writedown burden with downside news reaction and stock-comp discipline.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_wdpq)), 126), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * news_low_exc_stddev, 60), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * allocated_sbp_expense_total / sales, 126), industry)
notes: Uses vec_avg to avoid event-input arithmetic errors observed in v16.
